population: all 850 jobs, 425 pools, 26 previously inspected development tasks. Historical source findings known. No new task confirmation.
decision_unit: paired task macro normalized regret; define gain as baseline minus intervention. Positive favors intervention. Use all ties uniformly; 10000 paired task-cluster bootstrap draws with seed 20261108093, leave each of 26 tasks out. Always report hit, unique reads, heterogeneity.
coverage_diagnostic: On all J1 episodes and improved/unchanged/worsened subsets identify actual best candidate(s), query degree, valid degree and correctly directed ever-beaten competitors. Distinguish no incident query, all incident edges abstain, one or multiple valid edges, lack of distinguishing evidence and tie-break suppression in all-correct graph. Count valid undefeated competitors (incl. unobserved separately); best selected/partial tie/miss; describe an example and contributions with explicit denominators.
allocation: At same random chain (Random(seed) shuffle input IDs; n-1 edges), choose unseen edge maximizing lexicographic (number of zero-valid-degree endpoints, -min(valid degrees), -sum(valid degrees), -sum(queried degrees)); uniform among ties with label-free seeded shuffled sorted candidates/edges. Continue to original job budget. Compare to coverage_random full and C0 (whole procedure); fixed top_set. Run real v1 CLI plus evaluate; record failures. Prediction: better valid coverage and lower loss.
fixed_schedule: Use the previously recorded complete coverage_random schedule, which is independent of outcomes; verify zero-label schedule. For each of four banks use exactly those edges, all jobs. Independently recompute baseline gate .7 plus existing win fraction then valid degree.
gate: Gate-only change .7 to .5 incl with properly parsed raw index, confidence defaults according to C0; preserve invalid responses without direction. No hyperparameter search. Prediction: more nonempty evidence and lower regret.
aggregation: Keep gate .7, change top code to maximum (w+1)/(d+2), then larger valid degree, then keep all ties incl d=0. Beta(1,1) fixed smoothing; diagnostic selection rule revision only. Test same method at gate .5 as prespecified interaction, report difference in differences. Prediction: smoothing avoids promotion on a single weakly-supported win.
judge: Matched single-draw replacement: DS vs each and task-first average of all three archived GPT-5.1 feedback banks on same pairs at the .7 legacy rule. Report judgment direction accuracy among accepted, abstentions, macro regret/hit; no token/currency or judge-only attribution beyond entire judge setting. All three GPT records are repeats on same tasks.
strong_controls: For DS also check the fixed gate/smoothing interventions along recorded random_pairs schedule (different seed path) and saved C0 unique-edge trace with same revealed edges; on C0 replay these are fixed-trace reaggregations and are not new full tournament runs. Compare to C0 actual selection separately; declare actual-query differences.
criteria: Common working margin 0.01 normalized regret. Research priority (not deployment) for a feasible single change requires DS gain >=.01 plus positive DS leave-one gains, and direction on >=2/3 GPT banks with positive pooled task-macro GPT gain. Distinguish CI excluding zero, otherwise descriptive. For allocation independent generator-bank replays required if initiated for promotion. For judge setting swap require positive >=.01 pooled gain over DS, all leave-one pooled positive and >=2 individual gains positive. If several qualify compare directly, use smaller intervention if indistinguishable and perform head-to-head; a combined arm alone requires follow-up for attribution. A default switch requires evidence vs actual C0, plus method freeze and fresh confirmation. If no arm qualifies, register a second mechanistically distinct finite intervention or calibrated diagnostic before claiming a priority; runtime limits and dev scope persist.
version: v1 official path only for allocation, new nondeploying evaluator-side diagnostic version frontier-02-fixed-graph-v1 for raw .5 directions, alternative judge or aggregation. Selection decisions recorded/sealed before score labels are joined. J1 oracle for diagnosis only.
cost: CPU only, zero paid API/remote GPU/full training; max 600s per analysis or official run; preserve failures and new output directory on retries.
